content.short: Market-neutral synthetic dollar, NUSD, earning yield from OTC arbitrage and basis trades.
content.description: Neutrl turns strategies usually run by institutional trading desks into an on-chain dollar. NUSD is backed by market-neutral positions across discounted OTC token deals, funding rates and basis trades, and staking it as sNUSD collects the yield, around 6.9% annualised so far with $6 million distributed. It holds about $42 million in TVL, uses LayerZero to reach many chains, and raised $5 million led by STIX and Accomplice.
content.meta: Stake NUSD as sNUSD to earn Neutrl's market-neutral yield from OTC arbitrage, funding and basis strategies.
